# orionbelt_machine_access (Resource)

The complete list of standing grants on one machine. Any other grant on the machine is revoked. Roles (admin, operator) and approved just-in-time requests are not grants and are not affected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manages every grant on the machine. Grants not listed here are revoked.
resource "orionbelt_machine_access" "web" {
  machine_id = orionbelt_agent.web.id

  grant {
    user_id      = orionbelt_user.engineer.id
    access_type  = "ssh"
    remote_users = ["deploy"]
    expires_at   = "2027-01-31T00:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `machine_id` (String)

### Optional

- `grant` (Block List) One grant. Each user_id and access_type pair may appear once. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--grant))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--grant"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grant`

Required:

- `access_type` (String)
- `user_id` (String)

Optional:

- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339 time the grant stops working. Null means never.
- `remote_users` (Set of String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import all grants on a machine by the machine ID.
terraform import orionbelt_machine_access.web <machine_id>
```
